post-rewrite:
#!/bin/sh
# stayawake-scan-on-clone (post-rewrite) — installed by `saw hook install` (#1195). Must never fail git.
/usr/local/bin/saw hook run --config '/home/me/my config.yml' post-rewrite "$@" </dev/null || true
_local="$(dirname "$0")/post-rewrite.local"
[ -x "$_local" ] && "$_local" "$@" || true
exit 0
#!/bin/sh
# stayawake-scan-on-clone (post-rewrite) — installed by `saw hook install` (#1195). Must never fail git.
_local="$(dirname "$0")/post-rewrite.local"
_feed() { [ -z "$_pairs" ] || printf '%s\n' "$_pairs"; }
_pairs="$(cat)"
_feed | /usr/local/bin/saw hook run --config '/home/me/my config.yml' post-rewrite "$@" || true
if [ -x "$_local" ]; then _feed | "$_local" "$@"; fi
exit 0
